title: sibbaldiopsis tridentata
intro: Sibbaldiopsis tridentata, commonly known as the Three-toothed Marigold or Western Sibbaldia, is a flowering plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Sibbaldiopsis tridentata include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and soothing respiratory issues, making it a valuable remedy in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
